$comment: THE BINDING. Every generator and every gate loads this file and asserts against it. One shared toolchain, many walled courses. A generator that will happily emit another course's prefix will eventually do it.

forbiddenPrefixes.$comment: Codes matching any other course's prefix are a hard build failure. Listed explicitly rather than inferred, so adding a course is a deliberate edit.

forbiddenStandardsYears.$comment: 84 of the 94 US codes changed meaning between 2026-27 and 2027-28. A code is not a stable identifier across years. Any item still claiming the prior year is a hard failure, not a warning.
